capabilities: Create untitled .gmi files from the side ribbon or file context menu
Open and edit .gmi files as Markdown
disambiguation: Not a Gemini protocol browser or client; it only creates and edits Gemtext (.gmi) files.
extras: Requires Obsidian 0.11.0 or later; installation is manual or via the community plugin list.
problem: Obsidian only edits Markdown files, so authors of Gemini-space Gemtext (.gmi) files have no way to create or edit them inside the app.
summary: Gemtext editor that lets users create and edit .gmi files in Obsidian as if they were Markdown notes, for the Gemini web protocol.
